a.lede: Anthropic’s CEO says that safety hinges on understanding how AI “thinks.” So far the evidence is disturbing.
a.title: If the AI Industry Followed Its Own Research, It Might Have Paused Already

b.lede: AI leaders have been promising that AI is the key to curing human disease. Anthropic researchers have also been warning that AI might kill us all.
b.title: Anthropic is operating a lab that conducts biology experiments
